sent_bad: The holding company's activities are limited to passive investment and oversight of the Bank, so the report focuses on the Bank's operations.

The Bank is community-oriented, offering savings products and concentrating on real estate-secured lending (residential construction, one- to four-family, multi-family, and commercial real estate), adjustable-rate residential mortgages (some not eligible for secondary-market sale), commercial business loans, and consumer loans.
Profitability depends primarily on **net interest income** (interest earned on loans and investments minus interest paid on deposits and borrowings) after provision for loan losses.

**Non-interest expense** consisted mainly of salaries and benefits, premises and equipment, advertising, interchange fees, postage, core deposit intangible amortization, taxes, professional fees, FDIC premiums, loan administration/foreclosure costs, data processing, and deposit operations, with occasional reductions from gains on sales of premises/equipment and OREO.
**Mortgage banking revenue** — selling fixed-rate residential mortgages (and completed custom construction/owner-builder loans) into the secondary market with servicing retained.
